subject.title: feat: add weekly ClawHub design audit

question: Should ClawHub add a scheduled AI design audit that reads the private design-system repository and runs Codex with write access after the credential-isolation repair?
rationale: Code review can identify the token leak, but maintainers still need to approve the long-term trust boundary for scheduled AI automation with private design-system inputs and repository write permissions.

options.title: Keep draft until isolated and proven
options.body: Require isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME, no design-system or GitHub write tokens visible to Codex, secret-scanned or redacted artifacts, and one hosted workflow proof before marking ready.

options.title: Limit to local/manual audit first
options.body: Keep the scripts but disable the schedule and repository-writing PR automation until the private-repo credential path is operationally approved.

options.title: Do not add scheduled AI audit
options.body: Close or replace the scheduled Codex audit if maintainers do not want private design-system material in this automation boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep draft until isolated and proven
recommendation.body: Require isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME, no design-system or GitHub write tokens visible to Codex, secret-scanned or redacted artifacts, and one hosted workflow proof before marking ready.
